name: Anittel
summary: National IT & telecommunications integrator for SME/regional Australia (ex-Peter Kazacos Business Advantage 2007, renamed Anittel ~Sep 2009, ACN 123 808 677); merged into Hostech Feb 2010; listed as Anittel Group (ASX:AYG); IT services sold to Inabox ~2015, then to 5G Networks 2018.

events.details: Founded as Peter Kazacos Business Advantage (PKBA).
IT-services business sold to Inabox (completed ~2015); 5G Networks bought Anittel from Inabox Aug 2018.
Listed shell Hostech Limited (ASX:HTC) renamed Anittel Group Limited 1 Dec 2010, giving Anittel its ASX listing (ASX:AYG).
